name: Tsuma Netori ~Onnakyoushi no Choukyou Nisshi~
original_name: 妻ネトリ ～女教師の調教日誌～
source:
Netori story in the present day. Various sexual disciplines taught in the school. Two types of training: in confinement and of assault.
The former focuses on torture-like acts, and the latter on the demoniac initiations to the pleasure.

Trying to protect her family, Makoto keeps silent about her being forced to undergo various sexual assaults. And after successive merciless trainings, she learns the truth...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE111035.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
当今的Netori故事。学校教授各种性学科。两种类型的训练：监禁和攻击。
前者侧重于类似酷刑的行为，后者则侧重于恶魔般的享乐行为。

为了保护家人，诚对自己被迫遭受各种性侵犯的事情保持沉默。而经过一次又一次无情的训练，她得知了真相……
